desc:
Ahhh... I believe I've discovered a **mistranslation** in *Strange and Bright Nature Deity.* In the chapters where Reimu summoned bullfinches to peck on lies, it's not from the celestials (which wouldn't make sense anyway since celestials like Tenshi are Buddhist.)

No, "Tenjin-sama" here is actually **Sugawara no Michizane.** And yes, according to *Wild and Horned Hermit* ([**Chapter 15**](https://mangadex.org/chapter/2699baaf-6c79-40a7-846b-e20f010cc702)), the Hakurei Shrine used to worship Michizane at some point.
